svg.title: Three powers of x
svg.desc: For x greater than 0: the green curve y = x squared rises steeply, the blue curve y = x to the one-half power (the square root of x) rises slowly, and the crimson curve y = x to the negative one power (1 over x) falls toward the x-axis. All three pass through the point (1, 1), because 1 to any power is 1.
